### Execute a transaction with EntityManager

Source: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/master/docs/docs/working-with-entity-manager/5-entity-manager-api.md

The `transaction` method runs multiple database requests in a single transaction. Use the provided manager instance for all operations within the transaction.

```typescript
await manager.transaction(async (manager) => {
    // NOTE: you must perform all database operations using the given manager instance
    // it's a special instance of EntityManager working with this transaction
    // and don't forget to await things here
})
```

--------------------------------

### setOnLocked skip_locked

Source: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/master/docs/docs/query-builder/1-select-query-builder.md

Use setOnLocked("skip_locked") to skip locked rows. Supported on MySQL 8+, Postgres, CockroachDB, SAP HANA.

```typescript
const users = await dataSource
    .getRepository(User)
    .createQueryBuilder("user")
    .setLock("pessimistic_write")
    .setOnLocked("skip_locked")
    .getMany()
```

--------------------------------

### Pessimistic write locking with setLock

Source: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/master/docs/docs/query-builder/1-select-query-builder.md

Use setLock("pessimistic_write") to acquire an exclusive lock on the selected rows. Supported on all listed databases.

```typescript
const users = await dataSource
    .getRepository(User)
    .createQueryBuilder("user")
    .setLock("pessimistic_write")
    .getMany()
```

--------------------------------

### QueryBuilder .where() with IsNull() operator

Source: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/master/docs/docs/data-source/5-null-and-undefined-handling.md

Use the IsNull() operator to correctly match NULL values in QueryBuilder. This generates 'WHERE post.text IS NULL' and returns matching rows.

```typescript
import { IsNull } from "typeorm"

await dataSource
    .createQueryBuilder(Post, "post")
    .where({ text: IsNull() })
    .getMany()
// Generates: WHERE post.text IS NULL
```

--------------------------------

### Lock tables with setLock

Source: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/master/docs/docs/query-builder/1-select-query-builder.md

Use the third argument to setLock to specify which tables to lock. Only supported in PostgreSQL/CockroachDB.

```typescript
const users = await dataSource
    .getRepository(Post)
    .createQueryBuilder("post")
    .leftJoin("post.author", "user")
    .setLock("pessimistic_write", undefined, ["post"])
    .getMany()
```
